title: Handover scenario tests with example rows
description: scenarios.json /2 in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/): /1 (docs/handover-scenarios.schema.json: `screens`, `skipped`, unchanged) plus `api` and `entities`. Written instead of /1 only when a bound structured test scenario of a requirement in the handover has examples carrying `given` or `then` rows (C4); otherwise the file is /1, byte for byte. `api` has one entry per such scenario (it does not depend on the handover's UI part), ordered by scenario id. Rows are literal JSON values, in file order, verbatim. Keys of `given` and `then` are the qualified entity ids `pack/Aggregate` (sorted); a row's fields are `id` (the aggregate's identity) plus the aggregate's declared fields. `given` is {} when an example has no seed rows. `entities` lists only the aggregates the rows use, with their fields, so a consumer needs no pack. MATCHING SEMANTICS (the contract the Factory's generated API tests follow; X4 pins this schema): seed the `given` rows, call the operation with the example's request body (the scenario's effect.body with the example's placeholder values), then query. A `then` row WITH `id`: the stored row of that entity with that id exists, and each listed field deep-equals the expected value. A `then` row WITHOUT `id`: at least one stored row of that entity deep-equals the expected value on every listed field. Fields and rows that are not listed are not checked; absence is not asserted. The repo implements a seed/query adapter (entity id -> storage) once; generated tests call it. The scenario files themselves are named by path and sha256, not copied. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-scenarios-2.example.json is the shared fixture.

screens.description: One entry per render screen with at least one compiled scenario, ordered by screen. A scenario of an overlay (hosted) spec is on the host's entry.

component.description: The page component the test imports and renders (the spec's `component`).

path.description: Registry path of the scenario file.

operation.description: The request the test waits for, resolved from contracts/openapi at freeze; path is the OpenAPI path as written. The test mocks it with `{p}` as `:p`, after the path part of the file's servers[0].url if it has one.

index.description: 1-based; the n in the test title.

skipped.description: Structured scenarios of a requirement in the handover that were not compiled, with the reason. Never dropped silently. Ordered by scenario id.

operation.description: The request the test waits for, resolved from contracts/openapi at freeze; path is the OpenAPI path as written. The test mocks it with `{p}` as `:p`, after the path part of the file's servers[0].url if it has one.

given.description: Seed rows: qualified entity id -> rows. {} when absent.

then.description: Expected rows after the call: qualified entity id -> rows (see MATCHING SEMANTICS).

entities.description: The aggregates the rows use, ordered by id.

fields.description: The aggregate's declared fields (the identity `id` is implicit), as read from the pack: name plus type, ref or oneOf.
